title: 第1章 月妃，夜弦月
novel_title: 九恶妃每日一问，陛下驾崩了吗？
content_zh:
大夏帝宫。

    紫金龙榻上。

    一个满头虚汗的青年“蹭”的坐了起来。

    青年二十左右的样子，五官容貌俊美不羁，但整个人虚弱的厉害，华贵的镶金白龙袍也遮盖不住纵欲过度后的病态苍白。

    “我这是在哪！”

    秦然一脸懵的扫视着周围环境。

    遍地的云雾升腾、宛如云上天宫般的大殿、堪比两个停车位大小的紫金龙榻，还有那一件件绘着精致云纹、充斥神秘气息的古朴装饰物……

    国家博物馆？

    还是…仙侠剧拍摄现场？

    【叮咚！】

    【欢迎来到玄黄大世界！】

    【本世界依据小说《假太监手段高，后宫妃子不经撩》打造而成！】

    【现在起，你将开启后宫生存挑战！】

    【在这里每存活一天，都将获得高额奖励！】

    【每日凌晨将进行完成度评估，根据难度及完成度下发奖励！】

    【今日生存难度：D级】

    【你的身份是——云江仙！】

    秦然瞪圆了眼睛。

    “卧槽！”

    “穿书了？？”

    “云江仙…这名字怎么有点熟。”

    他努力回忆了一下，没一会儿，整个人惊的差点跳起来。

    “帝族云家最后血脉…沉迷酒色的昏庸帝王…前期的炮灰配角…那个被妃子们各种设计祸害的倒霉蛋儿——云江仙？？”

    “陛下！时辰已到，您该翻牌子了~~”一个尖锐声音在大殿中回荡，透着一股子阴森劲儿。

    秦然浑身一激灵，“谁TM说话呢！”

    龙榻外，近百位太监宫女跪了一地。

    一个断眉瘦高老太监站在人群前方，手中恭敬举着托盘，上面摆放着九个玉色牌子。

    见此一幕，秦然眼皮直跳。

    他写的小说叫《假太监手段高，后宫妃子不经撩》。

    顾名思义，书中原本主角是大帝重生的小太监林安以及后宫的九位妃子。

    而云江仙，只是个五十章就噶的小小配角，这也是为什么秦然一下子没想到“云江仙”这个名字的原因。

    帝族云家为守国门，全族战死，只剩下云江仙这个纨绔。

    作为帝族云家最后血统，云江仙体内拥有大夏神朝积累万年的龙运。

    龙运是成就大帝境界的必需品之一！

    他在书中存在的意义，便是给主角团做嫁衣的。
content_en:
Daxia Imperial Palace.

    On the purple gold dragon couch.

    A young man covered in sweat sat up.

    The young man was about twenty years old, with handsome and unruly facial features, but he was extremely weak. His luxurious gold-inlaid white dragon robe could not cover up his morbid paleness after overindulgence.

    "Where am I!"

    Qin Ran scanned the surroundings with a confused expression.

    There are rising clouds and mist all over the place, a grand hall like a heavenly palace in the clouds, a purple and gold dragon couch that is as big as two parking spaces, and simple decorations painted with exquisite cloud patterns and full of mysterious atmosphere...

    National Museum?

    Or... the filming scene of a fairy tale?

    [Ding dong! 】

    【Welcome to the big world of Xuanhuang! 】

    [This world is based on the novel "The Fake Eunuch is So Skilled, and the Concubines in the Harem Are Flirted Without Flirting"! 】

    [From now on, you will start the harem survival challenge! 】

    【Every day you survive here, you will receive high rewards! 】

    [Completeness evaluation will be conducted every morning, and rewards will be issued based on difficulty and completion! 】

    [Today’s survival difficulty: D level]

    [Your identity is - Yunjiangxian! 】

    Qin Ran's eyes widened.

    "Fuck!"

    "Through the book??"

    "Yunjiangxian...why does this name sound familiar?"

    He tried to recall it, and after a while, he almost jumped up in shock.

    "The last bloodline of the Yun family of the imperial family...the fatuous emperor addicted to wine and sex...the cannon fodder supporting role in the early stage...the unlucky guy who was harmed by the concubines' various designs - Yun Jiangxian??"

    "Your Majesty! The time has come, it's time for you to turn over your cards~~" A sharp voice echoed in the hall, with a sinister tone.

    Qin Ran was shocked, "Who the hell is talking!"

    Outside the dragon couch, nearly a hundred eunuchs and maids knelt on the ground.

    A tall, thin old eunuch with broken eyebrows stood in front of the crowd, respectfully holding a tray with nine jade-colored plaques on it.

    Seeing this scene, Qin Ran's eyelids jumped.

    The novel he wrote is called "The Fake Eunuch is So Skilled, and the Concubine in the Harem Can't Be Flirted".

    As the name suggests, the original protagonists of the book were Lin An, the young eunuch who was reborn by the emperor, and the nine concubines in the harem.

    Yunjiangxian, on the other hand, is just a small supporting character who only appears in Chapter 50. This is why Qin Ran didn't think of the name "Yunjiangxian" at once.

    The entire Yun family of the imperial clan died in the battle to defend the country, leaving only Yun Jiangxian, a playboy.

    As the last bloodline of the Yun family of the imperial clan, Yun Jiangxian possesses the dragon luck accumulated by the Great Xia Dynasty for thousands of years.

    Dragon Luck is one of the necessities for achieving the realm of the Great Emperor!

    The meaning of his existence in the book is to make wedding clothes for the protagonist group.
title_en: Chapter 1 Moon Concubine, Night Crescent Moon
